split_process: Predeclared 2026-10-11 in benchmark_decode_phase3ad.cpp before any oracle timing. Development holds the Phase 3A corpus, every supported Phase 3A-RC case, and new research-generator 1080p samples. Validation holds unobserved research resolutions, an alternate seed, validation-only families, new 8K Phase 3A patterns, and real re-encoded photographs when the manifest exists. Hold-out identities are compiled separately and are not encoded in dev-val mode.
